positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented the Scribd Reader Android app, which is available in the Android Market.
Built Scribd Reader with no prior Android experience, as part of a three-person team on which I was the sole full-time Android developer.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff on the Workstation and Player UI Team
positions.description:
Designed many features on VMware’s Workstation and Player products. Implemented features in both platform-common code and on the Linux platform using C++ and GTK+.  Participated in four Workstation/Player releases.

• Tech Lead for VMware Player on Linux. Drove overall new feature development for the product from the technical standpoint. Provided architectural guidance to other developers. Evangelized prioritization of the product internally.

• Created and implemented a ground-up redesign of the Player interface that added fundamental features such as Virtual Machine creation and editing.

• Led a redesign of the entire Workstation menu system to make it more intuitive and usable.

• Designed and implemented an improved fullscreen mode and toolbar in Workstation.

• Designed and implemented a User Experience Improvement Program to collect and analyze usage data from instances of Workstation and Player running in the wild.

• Designed and implemented a generalized IPC system, then leveraged that system to allow users to quickly switch between powered-on Virtual Machines in Player.

• Redesigned and updated the homepage and Virtual Machine summary page views in Workstation.

• Mentored a summer intern through a successful feature design and implementation project.

positions.title: Stage Manager
positions.description: Stage Managed 'Romeo and Juliet' and 'The King and I', both directed by Bill Olson.

positions.title: Assistant Stage Manager
positions.description: Assistant Stage Managed 'The King and I', directed by Marilyn Vaillancourt and Stage Managed by Phil Genera.

positions.title: Embedded Systems Intern
positions.description:
Worked closely with a product development team to implement a state machine in C that drives all operations of a wireless personal audio monitor system. 

Designed and implemented a menu system optimized for memory constraints and transferability.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Tested and debugged a major software release as part of a team of programmers. Authored and edited a test procedure for the field testing of an anthrax detection unit.

positions.title: User Research Lab Assistant
positions.description: Assisted in the debugging and implementation of a published psycholinguistic measurement tool written in Perl, including analysis of experimental data. Assisted with running experiments and became familiar with experimental design and procedures.
